messages:
tom_h: Hey support — I tried to apply the voucher CODE-APRIL50 at checkout but it says "invalid or expired". I think I got it in the onboarding email yesterday. Can someone check? (account email: tom+redwood@example.com)

maya_support: Sorry about that! Can you DM me the full code and the email you signed up with? Also screenshot if possible :slightly_smiling_face:

Tom_h: Full code is CODE-APRIL50. Screenshot: https://file-server.internal/snap123.png

maya_support: Thanks. Can you confirm whether you used SSO (Google) or email/pass to sign up?

tom_h: Google SSO

maya_support: Got it. Looking up your account... one sec.

maya_support: @systems_bot lookup_voucher CODE-APRIL50

systems_bot: voucher CODE-APRIL50 | status: redeemed | redeemed_by: tom@example.com | redeemed_at: 2025-04-02T15:12:04Z

maya_support: It shows the voucher was already redeemed by tom@example.com — that's a different address (no +alias). Do you have another Redwood account using that email?

tom_h: Huh I do have an old account tom@example.com (used for a PoC last year). I forgot. That account probably claimed it.

maya_support: That explains the error — the frontend shows "invalid/expired" when the voucher's already used. We can either transfer the credit or issue a manual credit to your SSO account. Which do you prefer?

tom_h: Manual credit to my SSO account please (tom+redwood@example.com). I need it for a demo tomorrow.

maya_support: Understood. I'll escalate to billing ops for a one-time credit and keep you posted.

maya_support: @lee_billing can you grant $50 trial credit to account tom+redwood@example.com and note: manual voucher transfer CODE-APRIL50? ETA today if possible.

lee_billing: On it — putting in manual credit now. Need org id for SSO account. @maya_support can you paste the account id?

maya_support: account id U_87a3f2 (tom+redwood@example.com)

lee_billing: Confirmed — created credit txn C-20250409-789, amount $50, applied to U_87a3f2. Should show in billing portal in ~5 mins. Added note referencing CODE-APRIL50 and original redemption on tom@example.com

lee_billing: Also added tag 'manual-voucher-transfer' for audit.

maya_support: Tom, you should see the $50 credit in Settings → Billing within a few minutes. Can you confirm once you see it?

tom_h: I see it, thanks!! :tada: Appreciate the quick turnaround.

maya_support: Glad it worked. We'll follow up with product to make the UX clearer (error text for "already redeemed" vs "expired").

lee_billing: FYI we flagged the original tom@example.com account — it may have been created by a teammate. No further action needed.

tom_h: Closing this out. Thanks all :)
